params.body:
The explainer "The importance of being verified", moved out of the claude.ai artifact
(version 68) into this repository.

- `index.html`: the page as a plain static file, without the artifact's wrapper. Open it in a
  browser; there is no build step.
- `img/shane.png`: the avatar that the artifact embedded eight times, now one file (the page
  went from 170 to 49 kB).
- `README.md`: what the page may claim, and the source of every number on it (the claim
  register at control `94df22c`, `docs/verify-yourself.md`, the chapters of the standard, the
  sha256 of `globals.css`).
- `npm test` (`test/check.mjs`, no dependencies) fails on an em dash or a middle dot, on a tier
  or "conformant" claimed for the system as a whole, on a missing image, and when the statline
  stops naming the register commit. Four deliberate mutations confirmed it bites.

What the page says about where we stand follows the register: six claims, two at Tier 3, four
at Tier 2, all four waiting on row 8.1.5 (an outsider's recorded verification). Stage
Self-Declared.
params.title: The explainer as a repository: index.html, the photo, README and the check
